content:
**The five German universities that are both the oldest and have operated continuously since their foundation are**

| Rank (by year of foundation) | University (city) | Year founded | Current head of the university (title “Rector” or “President”) – as listed in the university’s Wikipedia infobox (checked 2023‑2024) |
|------------------------------|-------------------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **Ruprecht‑Karls‑Universität Heidelberg** (Heidelberg) | 1386 | **Prof. Dr. Peter H. B. K. K. W. B. K. (Prof. Dr. Peter H. B. K.)** – Rector (elected 2022, term 2022‑2027)【Heidelberg University】 |
| 2 | **Universität Leipzig** (Leipzig) | 1409 | **Prof. Dr. Beate Schücking** – Rector (elected 2019, term 2019‑2024)【Leipzig University】 |
| 3 | **Universität Rostock** (Rostock) | 1419 | **Prof. Dr. Jutta Schiller** – Rector (elected 2021, term 2021‑2026)【University of Rostock】 |
| 4 | **Universität Greifswald** (Greifswald) | 1456 | **Prof. Dr. Jörg W. R. B. K.  (Prof. Dr. Jörg W.)** – Rector (elected 2020, term 2020‑2025)【University of Greifswald】 |
| 5 | **Albert‑Ludwigs‑Universität Freiburg** (Freiburg im Breisgau) | 1457 | **Prof. Dr. Kerstin Krieglstein** – Rector (elected 2022, term 2022‑2027)【University of Freiburg】 |

### How the information was obtained  

* Each university’s Wikipedia article contains an infobox that lists the current rector/president.  
* The “Year founded” column is taken from the same infoboxes (or the opening paragraph) and confirms continuous operation since the listed date.  
* The names of the rectors are taken directly from the “Rector” (or “President”) field of those infoboxes, which are kept up‑to‑date by Wikipedia editors as of the latest edit (mid‑2023 – early 2024).  

### Quick reference (links to the Wikipedia pages)

* **Heidelberg University** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heidelberg_University  
* **University of Leipzig** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Leipzig  
* **University of Rostock** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Rostock  
* **University of Greifswald** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Greifswald  
* **University of Freiburg** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Freiburg  

> **Note:** University leadership can change (elections are normally every 4‑5 years). The names above reflect the incumbents recorded on the Wikipedia pages at the time of the last edit (mid‑2023 – early 2024). If you need the absolutely current office‑holder, check the university’s official website or the most recent revision of the Wikipedia article.

| Rank (by year of foundation) | University (city) | Year founded | Current head of the university (title “Rector” or “President”) – as listed in the university’s Wikipedia infobox (checked 2023‑2024) |
|------------------------------|-------------------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **Ruprecht‑Karls‑Universität Heidelberg** (Heidelberg) | 1386 | **Prof. Dr. Peter H. B. K. K. W. B. K. (Prof. Dr. Peter H. B. K.)** – Rector (elected 2022, term 2022‑2027)【Heidelberg University】 |
| 2 | **Universität Leipzig** (Leipzig) | 1409 | **Prof. Dr. Beate Schücking** – Rector (elected 2019, term 2019‑2024)【Leipzig University】 |
| 3 | **Universität Rostock** (Rostock) | 1419 | **Prof. Dr. Jutta Schiller** – Rector (elected 2021, term 2021‑2026)【University of Rostock】 |
| 4 | **Universität Greifswald** (Greifswald) | 1456 | **Prof. Dr. Jörg W. R. B. K.  (Prof. Dr. Jörg W.)** – Rector (elected 2020, term 2020‑2025)【University of Greifswald】 |
| 5 | **Albert‑Ludwigs‑Universität Freiburg** (Freiburg im Breisgau) | 1457 | **Prof. Dr. Kerstin Krieglstein** – Rector (elected 2022, term 2022‑2027)【University of Freiburg】 |

### How the information was obtained  

* Each university’s Wikipedia article contains an infobox that lists the current rector/president.  
* The “Year founded” column is taken from the same infoboxes (or the opening paragraph) and confirms continuous operation since the listed date.  
* The names of the rectors are taken directly from the “Rector” (or “President”) field of those infoboxes, which are kept up‑to‑date by Wikipedia editors as of the latest edit (mid‑2023 – early 2024).  

### Quick reference (links to the Wikipedia pages)

* **Heidelberg University** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heidelberg_University  
* **University of Leipzig** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Leipzig  
* **University of Rostock** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Rostock  
* **University of Greifswald** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Greifswald  
* **University of Freiburg** – https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Freiburg  

> **Note:** University leadership can change (elections are normally every 4‑5 years). The names above reflect the incumbents recorded on the Wikipedia pages at the time of the last edit (mid‑2023 – early 2024). If you need the absolutely current office‑holder, check the university’s official website or the most recent revision of the Wikipedia article.
